sloka: स पपात खरो भूमौ दह्यमानः शर अग्निना ।रुद्रेण एव विनिर्दग्धः श्वेत अरण्ये यथा अन्धकः ॥३-३०-२७॥
transliteration: sa papāta kharo bhūmau dahyamānaḥ śara agninā ।rudreṇa eva vinirdagdhaḥ śveta araṇye yathā andhakaḥ ॥3-30-27॥

translations.english: Just as Yama was burnt by Rudra's fire(from his eyes) in Swetaranya, Khara collapsed on the ground consumed by the fire of Rama's arrow.
translations.hindi: हुई, गीराम जी के तामापतन्तीं Me गृत्युपाशोपमां गदाम्‌ । अन्त रामथिच्छेद्‌ बहुधा शरैः
